units.text: We examined how stable three types of measures were across four visits. Symptom scores were less stable than trait scores. This indicates that the distinction between states and traits is a matter of degree.
Scores on the scale mainly reflected stable differences between patients. The visit-specific part was smaller than for mood scales.
